solstice.module.render.name: Render Optimizations
solstice.module.render.desc: Reduces GPU overhead via minimized-sleep, dynamic render distance, and batched draw-call pruning.
solstice.module.entity_culling.name: Entity Culling
solstice.module.entity_culling.desc: Skips rendering entities hidden behind terrain, reducing GPU draw calls significantly.
solstice.module.particle_limiter.name: Particle Limiter
solstice.module.particle_limiter.desc: Caps maximum live particles to prevent particle-heavy scenes from tanking frame time.
solstice.module.chunk.name: Chunk Optimizations
solstice.module.chunk.desc: Prioritizes nearby chunk builds, throttles distant rebuilds, and skips empty section meshing.
solstice.module.memory.name: Memory Optimization
solstice.module.memory.desc: Trims heap usage via intelligent GC hints and cache pruning to reduce GC pause stutters.
solstice.module.network.name: Network Optimizations
solstice.module.network.desc: Tunes socket buffers and TCP settings for lower latency and higher throughput.
solstice.module.startup.name: Startup Optimizations
solstice.module.startup.desc: Reduces splash-screen minimum display time to shorten time-to-main-menu.
solstice.screen.title: Solstice Settings
